[quote=tirakan;60750093][b]Naerim Ministry of External Affairs - Official Diplomatic Communication[/b]
[b]Cooperation for Peace and Independence in Tirakan[/b]
[Spoiler]
Esteemed representatives of the Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah,

The government and people of Naerim express their respect and gratitude for your words calling for peace and reconciliation in both Tirakan and Valddera. We recognize the difficulty of maintaining neutrality amid such chaos, and we commend the Sultanate of Baladullah for voicing the principles of justice and human dignity at a time when they are under assault across our region.
Naerim welcomes any initiative that seeks to end the suffering of civilians and restore lawful order through dialogue and mutual recognition, not conquest. We share your wish to see the Shamats free of bloodshed and instability, and we are open to working with Baladullah in any way required to achieve that aim.
However, we must be equally clear. While we respect Baladullahs right to choose its diplomatic path, Naerim cannot and will not recognize the Peoples Republic of Valddera. That regimes military alignment with the Renaissance Union, a movement dedicated to reinstating authoritarian rule and silencing civic freedom, makes such recognition incompatible with our founding principles.
Naerim does nt seek domination, but full independence and a permanent end to the cycle of monarchy, dictatorship, and clerical violence that has destroyed Tirakan. We believe peace can only be lasting if every nation acknowledges these same values.

We therefore propose that Baladullah and Naerim establish direct diplomatic channels to coordinate new measures in Tirakan.

With respect,

[i]Arlen Vos, Acting Premier of the Free Republic of Naerim[/i]
[/spoiler]

[b]Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/b]

[u]Establishment of a Diplomatic Channel to Coordinate Humanitarian Aid and Facilitate a Ceasefire[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

We appreciate the encouraging words in response to our communiqué, and we understand what it is like to fight against a military dictatorship. From 1956 to 1978, our people fought against an Arab supremacist military regime led by Colonel Omar al-Jabbari and hundreds of thousands died for liberation, may they be martyrs in Paradise in shaa Allah. We only wish the best for all the people of Tirakan, and hope to play a role that facilitates peace and human rights for all. 

We respect the decision of the government of Naerim regarding its policy towards the PRV. They are an ally of ours that shares a similar socialist economic philosophy and religious identity, but we will not let our ties with them get in the way of genuine engagement with you or any other side in the civil war that truly seeks a resolution to the conflict and the protection of civilians. 

We propose a humanitarian corridor throughout Tirakan to facilitate humanitarian aid and to help civilians get to safe areas, and the establishment of some sort of conflict free zone in the area for temporary resettlement of refugees. In shaa Allah this is also in the interest of Naerim and other parties to the conflict.

Once again, we extend an invite to the other factions in the civil war to engage in dialogue to at least establish a ceasefire and protect civilians, and call on all parties to show utmost restraint in their actions. In shaa Allah there can be peace, good governance, security, and justice for everyone there.

[i]Abdoul Mahonomayi

[quote=tirakan;60750453][b]Official Communiqué - Free Republic of Naerim
To the free Governments and People of Erene [/b]

Honoured Leaders, Allies, and Partners in the Pursuit of Peace,

The Free Republic of Naerim addresses you today as East Shamats last resort against tyranny and bloodshed.
Our land, once a part of Tirakan, now bears the full weight of two collapsing orders, the militarist Renaissance Union and the theocratic Holy League. Both are determined to erase every voice that speaks for liberty, knowledge, and human dignity. They harass our borders whilst we not only defend our, and those of our precious allies in the Coastal Alliance, but also the seas together with brave soldiers of [nation]Valodya[/nation], to allow safe trade across the Shamat Sea, where we supply many of your households with cheap gas.

But the Unions of Evil within Tirakan? They call their wars reunification and purification. We call them what they are, the sadistic tyrannts aiming to destroy civilisation.
Our cities are shelled. Our capital has been bombed. Our Premier, Kareth Onu, was murdered by suicide attackers only days ago. We've called out to them to bring more, as yet still, we stand.

We reach out today to the independent governments and free peoples of [nation]Baladullah[/nation], [nation]Vespurias[/nation], [nation]Skullsbrough[/nation], [nation]Karcovshkie[/nation], [nation]Greater Rostoria[/nation], [nation]Neue Republik[/nation], [nation]Cervantasdill[/nation], [nation]Italian Dutch[/nation] and [nation]Hyunseo[/nation], not as beggars, but as survivors of fanatism, tyranny and despotic megalomaniacal dictators.

Naerim is fighting for a free and plural Tirakan, one where no crown or creed dictates the worth of a person. But ideals alone cannot stop bullets, nor feed the families living beneath the whistling sound of death on artillery fields.
We therefore call for immediate assistance from your nations, each of which understands that it will take all of you to achieve more than just mere armistice.
Today we require, arms, defensive technology, manpower, training assistance, humanitarian aid, and tomorrow, when we step forth as victors over the illegitimate crown, it will be re-construction material and financial aid to rebuild the once been trade axis and resourceful paradise of the Shamat and North Sea, that many of us used to profit from shaking hands with.
It will be the technology, developed through our despair in war, joint construction contracts, open trade, harbor shares, gas and regional stability that will serve not only you but the greater good of Erene.

Naerim fights not to expand, but to survive the repeated attacks on our sovereignty.
If we fall, there will be no free coast left in Tirakan, no line of resistance to stand between tyranny, the sea and you.

The war is no longer local. It is the front line between progress and civilian massacre.
Let us join hands, and the dictators will creep forwards, as theres a gun in the back of their head.

[b]A morgna ves core. Vectern sis da[/b].

[i]Arlen Vos, Acting Premier of the Free Republic of Naerim[/i]
